bai: Bai 25 - Lap trinh VBA trong Excel (2h16p)
cong_thuc: Alt+F11 (hoac Developer > Visual Basic): mo cua so lap trinh VBE.
Sub SayHello() ... End Sub: khung chuong trinh; ten viet lien, khong dau cach/ky tu dac biet; F5 hoac nut tam giac de chay.
MsgBox "Hello World": hien hop thong bao; vi du kinh dien dau tien moi ngon ngu.
Cells(1,1) = "Hello": gan chu vao o hang 1 cot 1 (A1); Cells(hang,cot).
Ctrl+G (View > Immediate Window): mo cua so Immediate de test tung lenh; ?1+1 tra 2; go Cells(2,3)="Ga Excel" + Enter chay ngay.
Sheets("Sheet1").Select: chon sheet theo TEN; Sheets(1).Select: chon theo SO THU TU.
Sheets(3).Name = "Ga Excel": doi ten sheet thu 3.
ActiveWorkbook / Workbooks("Book1"): file dang lam viec / file chi dinh; ActiveSheet (sheet dang chon), ActiveCell.
Workbooks("Book1").Sheets(2).Cells(2,1) = "Xin chao": truy cap cheo file khac dang mo: Workbook.Sheet.Cells.
Dim y As Integer: khai bao bien so nguyen (-32768..32767); Dim n As Long (+-2 ty); Single/Double (so thap phan); String (chuoi); Object; Variant (moi kieu).
y = 5 : Cells(1,1) = y: gan bien vao o; doi y=7 chay lai thi o doi theo.
Range("A1:B3") = "Ga Excel": gan ca vung lien tuc; Range("A5") = "Xin chao": 1 o.
Cells(7,2).Select / Range(...).Select: chon vung; Range(...).Clear hoac = "" de xoa; = "" trong ngoac kep la xoa nhanh.
For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Sheets ... Next: quet tung sheet; If ws.Name <> ActiveSheet.Name Then ws.Delete: xoa sheet khac sheet dang dung.
Application.DisplayAlerts = False ... = True: tat/bat hop hoi 'co chac muon xoa'; nho bat lai keo nguy hiem.
For i = 10 To 20 Step 1 ... Next: lap so lan co dinh; dung de in tu thi sinh 10..20 thay vi While het danh sach.
Do While ... Loop / Do Until: lap khi con dieu kien (in het danh sach phieu diem).
Sheet2.PrintOut Preview:=False: in sheet (False=in that, True=chi xem truoc); khong may in thi dung PDF de test.
Dim fso As Object: Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject"): tao doi tuong thao tac file.
If fso.FolderExists(duongdan) = False Then MsgBox "Khong ton tai" : Exit Sub : End If: kiem tra thu muc nguon/dich truoc khi copy.
fso.CopyFile Source:=nguon & kieuFile, Destination:=dich: copy file (*.* hoac *.xlsx) giua 2 thu muc.
Dim olApp As Object, olMail As Object: Set olApp = CreateObject("Outlook.Application"): goi ung dung Outlook (can Tools > References > Outlook 16.0).
olMail.To / .Subject / .HTMLBody / .Attachments.Add duongdan / .Send: gui mail (To, tieu de, noi dung HTML, dinh kem, gui).
olMail.BodyFormat = olFormatHTML: gui dinh dang HTML de chu ten duoc bo dam.
Application.WorksheetFunction.Substitute(body, cu, moi): ham SUBSTITUTE trong VBA de thay ten/ma khuyen mai cho tung nguoi; CountA dem so nguoi nhan.
SoNguoi = WorksheetFunction.CountA(Sheets(1).Range("B2:B100")): dem email; For i = 2 To SoNguoi: Cells(i,2/3/4/5) lay email/ten/ma/file dinh kem.
Dau _ (gach duoi) cuoi dong: xuong dong code (noi 2 dong thanh 1 lenh) cho de doc.
Right-click Project > Insert > Module: viet code trong Module (theo file), khong viet tren Sheet (mat khi xoa sheet).
Luu .xlsm + gan macro vao Button (Developer > Insert > Button > Assign Macro) de bam chay: in hang loat, xoa sheet, copy file, gui mail.
y = InputBox("Nhap mot so") : hien hop nhap lieu, gan vao bien y de kiem tra tiep.
If y Mod 2 = 0 Then MsgBox y & " la so chan" Else MsgBox y & " la so le" End If: Mod lay du; If...Then...Else...End If re nhanh chan/le (If va End If bat buoc di cap).
For i = 2 To SoNguoi ... Next + If ... Then ... End If: vong lap For quet dong 2..CountA, If kiem tra dieu kien tung dong (in phieu, xoa sheet, gui mail).
thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: bat Developer (Customize Ribbon); Alt+F11 mo VBE; View > Immediate (Ctrl+G); Insert > Module.
Buoc 2: viet Sub SayHello + MsgBox, F5 chay; doi sang Cells(1,1)=...; test lenh le trong Immediate (?1+1, Cells).
Buoc 3: hoc Cell/Range/Sheet/Workbook: Cells(hang,cot), Range("A1:B3"), Sheets(ten/so), Workbooks(...).Sheets(...).Cells(...); Dim bien Integer/Long/String/Variant.
Buoc 4 (in phieu): record/viet vong While quet thi sinh + PrintOut Preview:=False; gan nut 'In danh sach'; dung For i=10 To 20 de in 1 doan.
Buoc 5 (xoa sheet): viet For Each ws + If Name<>Active thi Delete, boc Application.DisplayAlerts False/True; gan nut.
Buoc 6 (copy file): lay duong dan nguon/dich + kieu (*.*), viet FSO CopyFile + FolderExists check + MsgBox; gan nut.
Buoc 7 (gui mail): Tools > References tick Outlook; viet CreateObject Outlook + vong For i=2 To CountA + Substitute thay ten/ma + HTMLBody + Attachments.Add + Send; gan nut 'Gui email'; luu .xlsm.

cau_hoi.cau: VBA viet tat cua cum nao?
cau_hoi.A: Visual Basic for Applications
cau_hoi.giai_thich: VBA nhung trong Excel de tu dong hoa thao tac.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi nao nen hoc VBA?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Thao tac thu cong lap lai, ton thoi gian, nham chan
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Viec lap di lap lai nhieu lan la luc can tu dong.

cau_hoi.cau: Uu diem lon nhat cua VBA?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Nhanh, chinh xac, lam viec nguoi khong the
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chay hang nghin thao tac trong giay, khong nham.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhuoc diem cua VBA?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Can tu duy bien, vong lap, dieu kien.

cau_hoi.cau: Mo cua so lap trinh VBA bang?
cau_hoi.A: Alt+F11
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hoac Developer > Visual Basic.

cau_hoi.cau: Khung 1 chuong trinh VBA bat dau/ket thuc?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ten viet lien, khong dau cach.

cau_hoi.cau: Chay chuong trinh trong VBE bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: F5 hoac nut tam giac xanh
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bam F5 de thuc thi Sub hien tai.

cau_hoi.cau: Lenh hien hop thong bao Hello?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Vi du kinh dien dau tien moi ngon ngu.

cau_hoi.cau: Gan chu vao o A1 bang?
cau_hoi.A: Cells(1,1) = "Hello"
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Cells(hang,cot): hang 1 cot 1 la A1.

cau_hoi.cau: Cua so Immediate mo bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Noi test tung lenh le khong can Sub.

cau_hoi.cau: Trong Immediate go ?1+1 thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dau ? la lenh in ket qua.

cau_hoi.cau: Go Cells(2,3)="Ga Excel" trong Immediate thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: O hang 2 cot 3 (C2) nhan chu ngay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Immediate thuc thi lenh don tuc thi.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon sheet theo TEN dung?
cau_hoi.A: Sheets("Sheet1").Select
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Truyen dung ten trong ngoac kep.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon sheet theo SO THU TU dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So 1 la sheet dau tien tu trai.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi ten sheet thu 3 thanh Ga Excel?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Thuoc tinh .Name de dat ten sheet.

cau_hoi.cau: ActiveWorkbook nghia la?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Lenh khong ro workbook se tac dong file active.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon gan vao Book1 khi dang o Book2 thi?
cau_hoi.A: Workbooks("Book1").Sheets(2).Cells(2,1)=...
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chi ro Workbook.Sheet.Cells de truy cap cheo.

cau_hoi.cau: Khai bao bien so nguyen dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Integer tu -32768 den 32767.

cau_hoi.cau: So lon hon 32767 dung kieu nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Long chua so nguyen lon.

cau_hoi.cau: Kieu chua duoc MOI loai gia tri?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chua xac dinh thi dung Variant.

cau_hoi.cau: Kieu doi tuong Excel (Sheet/Range) la?
cau_hoi.A: Object
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Object dai dien cac doi tuong.

cau_hoi.cau: Doan y=5: Cells(1,1)=y cho ket qua?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bien y mang gia tri 5 gan vao o.

cau_hoi.cau: Gan ca vung A1:B3 cung 1 chu dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Range nhan ca vung lien tuc.

cau_hoi.cau: Xoa nhanh vung bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Clear xoa, gan chuoi rong cung xoa.

cau_hoi.cau: Lenh chon vung de thao tuc la?
cau_hoi.A: .Select
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Select chon vung truoc khi xu ly.

cau_hoi.cau: Quet TAT CA sheet trong file dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Sheets ... Next
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Vong For Each duyet tung Worksheet.

cau_hoi.cau: Chi giu ActiveSheet, xoa sheet khac dung dieu kien?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khac ten sheet active thi xoa.

cau_hoi.cau: Xoa sheet bang code hien hop xac nhan thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: False tat canh bao, xong bat lai True.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi sao phai bat lai DisplayAlerts=True?
cau_hoi.A: Lan sau Excel mai mai khong hoi, de xoa nham
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Quen bat lai rat nguy hiem cho nguoi dung sau.

cau_hoi.cau: In sheet bang code dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: False=in that; True=chi xem truoc.

cau_hoi.cau: Khong co may in test lenh in bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon PDF, no hoi ten file de luu.

cau_hoi.cau: In tu thi sinh 10 den 20 dung vong nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: For co dinh so lan, khong dung While duyet het.

cau_hoi.cau: In HET danh sach khong biet truoc so luong dung?
cau_hoi.A: Do While ... Loop
cau_hoi.giai_thich: While lap den khi het thi sinh.

cau_hoi.cau: Tao doi tuong thao tac file dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: FSO de copy/kiem tra file thu muc.

cau_hoi.cau: Kiem tra thu muc ton tai truoc khi copy dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khong ton tai thi MsgBox + Exit Sub.

cau_hoi.cau: Copy file bang FSO dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Truyen nguon + kieu (*.*) va dich.

cau_hoi.cau: Gui mail tu Excel can bat gi truoc?
cau_hoi.A: Tools > References > tick Outlook Object Library
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khong reference thi khong goi duoc Outlook.

cau_hoi.cau: Tao ung dung mail trong code dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Doi tuong Outlook de tao thu.

cau_hoi.cau: Dia chi nguoi nhan gan vao thuoc tinh?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: .To lay tu cot email (Cells(i,2)).

cau_hoi.cau: Noi dung HTML (in dam ten) gan vao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: HTMLBody chua the <b> de dinh dang.
